data.name: Bunnyhop
data.detailed_description:
A little hop can bring everyone home.


Bunnyhop is a cute, cozy side-scrolling adventure about gathering food and helping friends before winter reaches Cloverbell Valley. Run, leap, dig, and occasionally take to the sky on a ribbon of rainbow picnic magic.

Gather through four changing seasons


Spring puddles bounce. Summer gardens overflow. Autumn leaves hurry the harvest. Winter turns the path slippery while the pantry keeps every bunny warm. Each season changes the scenery, food, music, and rhythm of the journey.

Make Mossbutton Burrow feel like home


Bring each basket home, welcome rescued Clovertrail Buddies, display keepsakes, and watch one tiny burrow grow into a warm bunny neighborhood. Every buddy has a name, a story, and a gentle helper perk.

Dress for the adventure


Discover expressive full-sprite outfits and playful picnic tools, then choose the Little Hopper's look in the wardrobe. Outfits are drawn into every pose so hats, capes, boots, and aprons move with the bunny.

Choose your kind of hop


  • Cozy Hop offers a gentler expedition.
  • Classic Pace adds a livelier fox chase and more mischievous encounters.
  • Run, jump, dig, send a Petal Puff, and fly with keyboard or game controller.
  • Find sky platforms, hidden treasure, picnics, seasonal surprises, and Courage Flowers.
  • Play as a complete offline single-player game with no ads, analytics, accounts, or in-app purchases.

The Rustle-Tail foxes are theatrical picnic raiders, not frightening villains. Send sneezes, tickles, and bubbles their way, or burrow safely underneath and keep the basket moving.
